paragraphs: The E-Pace P250 uses the Ingenium AJ200 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. It was fitted to the E-Pace from the model's launch in 2017 through to the end of production in 2024, across the X540 generation. The P250 sat above the P160 in the petrol range, offering a higher output tune of the same Ingenium 2.0-litre platform. The E-Pace is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace AJ200 engines for every E-Pace P250 on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine fitted to the E-Pace P250 from 2017 to 2024 (X540). No specific known issue confirmed for this application — we service it to the same standard as our other Ingenium rebuilds.

compatibility.intro: The E-Pace P250 uses a single engine family — the Ingenium AJ200 — across the entire X540 production run. We confirm your exact engine code via registration or VIN before any work begins, ensuring the correct parts and specification for your specific build.
